how_to_edit: Items taken out of the game but kept for later. The game never reads this file.
To bring one back, move its block into data/pickup_items.json (any_class, melee_only or ranged_only) and run tests/pickup_items_test.gd.
hearth_items: the Hearth's own copies of removed relics (they lived in data/hearth_campaign.json → items).

menders_sachet.name: Mender's Sachet
menders_sachet.description: Bitter herbs release a restorative breath when blood is first drawn.

turn_based.rules_text: The first time you fall below half health each combat, heal 3.

soldiers_buckle.name: Soldier's Buckle
soldiers_buckle.description: A drilled guard-oath steadies your stance just before a blow lands.

turn_based.rules_text: When a defensive reaction triggers, gain 1 Threshold for that attack.

windknotted_thread.name: Windknotted Thread
windknotted_thread.description: A pale cord pulls its wearer toward unoccupied ground.

turn_based.rules_text: With no adjacent enemies, gain +1 movement and +1 Evasion.

harvesters_gloves.name: Harvester's Gloves
harvesters_gloves.description: Warding straw and copper thread guide both steel and spell through chaff.

turn_based.rules_text: Against an enemy standing beside a destructible prop, gain +2 Accuracy.

redstep_spurs.name: Redstep Spurs
redstep_spurs.description: The spurs bite only when their wearer commits to a line of attack.

turn_based.rules_text: After moving at least 2 tiles, gain +2 Attack Power on the next martial attack.

moonleaf_cloak.name: Moonleaf Cloak
moonleaf_cloak.description: Moonleaf fibers blur at the edge of an attacker's vision.

turn_based.rules_text: While Hidden or before your first attack, gain +2 Armor Class.

pilgrims_greaves.name: Pilgrim's Greaves
pilgrims_greaves.description: The greaves harden with every deliberate step.

turn_based.rules_text: After moving at least 2 tiles, gain +2 Threshold until your next turn.

cinderheart_locket.name: Cinderheart Locket
cinderheart_locket.description: The Farmstead's last clean ember flares when its bearer is nearly spent.

turn_based.rules_text: Below half health, gain 2 fire Aegis and restore 1 additional health from consumables.

starfallen_sigil.name: Starfallen Sigil
starfallen_sigil.description: A patient silver star aligns weapon and spell trajectories alike.

combat.rules: Slasher: specials release a 45% arcane shockwave around you, once every 4 seconds.

turn_based.rules_text: On a natural 20, restore 1 class resource.

hearth_starfallen_sigil.name: Starfallen Sigil
hearth_starfallen_sigil.description: attack bonus +4, spell power +4, initiative modifier +2
